vulnerability.name: USN-5054-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5054-1 fixed a vulnerability in uWSGI for Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. This update provides the corresponding fixes for Ubuntu 14.04 ESM and Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Felix Wilhelm discovered a buffer overflow flaw in the mod_proxy_uwsgi module.  An attacker could use this vulnerability to provoke an information disclosure  or potentially remote code execution.

statements.status_notes: uWSGI could be made to crash if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
